title: Imported people
body: People imported from Notion stay as source references until an admin maps them to workspace accounts.
bodyMember: People imported from Notion stay as source references until they’re mapped. You can map the ones in pages you can edit.
onlyNamed: Only people named in values or mentions are listed. A Notion person named only as who made or last changed a page shows their Notion name there, with nothing here to map.
empty: No unmapped imported people were found.
applied: Mapped {{people}} people across {{pages}} rows/pages and {{blocks}} blocks.
skipped: People on pages you can’t open ({{pages}}) were left as they were.
